refresh.why: Nothing here is stable. In the 16 days from 2026-10-09 to 2026-10-25 OpenCode raised DeepSeek V4.1 Flash's limit from $60 to $80, put Gemini 4 Argon on a 50% token promo, and added Kimi K3.1 Pro ($15), Step 5 Preview ($15), MiniMax M3.1 Flash ($20) and Beam Free (unlimited) — none of which were in this file, so each was silently divided by the $30 defaultLimit and mis-ranked the value table. Artificial Analysis re-scored DeepSeek V4.1 Flash from 34.9 to 45.1 over the same span.
